errors.not-allowed: Microphone is blocked. Allow it from the icon in the address bar, then try again.
errors.service-not-allowed: This browser has speech recognition turned off.
errors.audio-capture: No microphone found. Plug one in or check your sound settings.
errors.network: Dictation needs an internet connection in this browser.
errors.language-not-supported: This language isn’t supported for dictation here.

dictation.nothingHeard: I didn’t catch anything. Try speaking a little longer.
dictation.downloadFailed: Couldn’t download the Whisper model. Check your connection.
dictation.whisperFailed: Local Whisper couldn’t transcribe that. Try again, or switch to browser dictation in Integrations.
dictation.hintCloud: Speak, then tap again. The clip goes to the speech provider you connected in Integrations.
dictation.hintWhisper: Speak, then tap again. Whisper turns it into text on this device: your audio never leaves your computer.
dictation.hintBrowser: Speak naturally; your words appear as you talk. Your browser’s speech service turns audio into text (in Chrome that’s Google). Prefer on-device? Choose local Whisper in Integrations.
dictation.unsupported: Browser dictation needs Chrome, Edge or Safari. Local Whisper in Integrations works in Firefox too.

ui.enterToSend: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
